plugins.name: nav
plugins.description: Keep any codebase navigable as it grows — audit (assess + feasibility + deep legacy sweep via domain fan-out), refactor (behaviour-preserving structural change with risk-proportional verification), sync (file-top headers, plus the bilingual codebase map as its map leg), plan (spec → grounded plan, carrying existing implementation authority), do (execute a small behaviour-changing change, disciplined, no artifact), compose (author/restructure a prose document as a deep module). Language-agnostic. Built on Ousterhout's deep-module principles (deep modules via information hiding).

plugins.name: shape
plugins.description: Forward motion: give intent its form via real disposable instances (not descriptions), record decisions legibly, and keep them current, then hand off to be built. Sibling to nav. Skills: park (save the session stopping point), catchup (recover current work from the handoff and evidence), mockup (render-to-decide), elicit (grounded clarification of a decision or cause, with an optional focused survey and no compulsory friction or reading detour), probe (a minimal experiment when nobody can settle a fork by argument), dogfood (use a built feature for real → friction + coverage gaps), align (verify → compact → triage in one pass, then render the plan), migrate (summon-only); doctor deferred. Language-agnostic.

plugins.name: frame
plugins.description: Apply an explicit, named frame that adds substantive reasoning checks without a fixed output worksheet — to a problem (three reasoning lenses: first-principles, orthogonal, dialectic) or to an answer you already have (analogize — a stress-tested analogy; draw — render it, with the form chosen by the kind of knowledge). Lenses feed shape one-way; analogize does not. Standalone. Renamed from think.

plugins.name: relay
plugins.description: Coordinate asynchronously through a verified GitHub workspace under the Accord memory model. Route independent follow-ups, expose native lifecycle findings and stage age, hand off the current baton without moving settlement authority, and commit exact settled memory directly. Language-agnostic.
